about.description:
The diffpy.srreal package provides calculators for atomic pair distribution
function (PDF), bond valence sums (BVS), atom overlaps for a hard-sphere
model, bond distances and directions up to specified maximum distance.   The
atomic structure models are represented with internal classes as non-periodic,
periodic or structures with space group symmetries.  The package provides
implicit adapters from diffpy.structure classes or from Crystal or Molecule
objects from pyobjcryst.  Adapters can be easily defined for any other
structure representations in Python allowing their direct use with the
calculators.  Calculators support two evaluation models - BASIC, which
performs a full pair-summation every time, and OPTIMIZED, which updates only
pair contributions that have changed since the last evaluation.  Calculations
can be split among parallel jobs using Python multiprocessing package or any
other library that provides parallel map function.  PDF calculations can
be done in two modes - either as a real-space summation of peak profiles
(PDFCalculator) or as a reciprocal-space Debye summation and Fourier
transform of the total scattering structure function (DebyePDFCalculator).
about.summary: Calculators for PDF, bond valence sum, and other quantities based on atom pair interaction.

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "diffpy.srreal" %}
{% set version = "1.5.1" %}
{% set build_number = 0 %}

# CPU and CUDA variants.  The CUDA variant has the higher build number, so it
# is preferred where it can be installed.
{% set build_variant = "cpu" %}    # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
{% set srreal_cuda = "OFF" %}      # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
{% set build_number = build_number + 100 %}                                  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
{% set build_variant = "cuda" ~ cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "") %}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
{% set srreal_cuda = "ON" %}                                                 # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/diffpy_srreal/diffpy_srreal-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a7b3f5a0ae6d4ed88535c17e53385753ea509a233db3a3609e97564822efb55b
  patches:
    # conda-forge provides the CUDA runtime as a package, link it dynamically
    - patches/0001-link-cudart-dynamically.patch

build:
  number: {{ build_number }}
  string: {{ build_variant }}_py{{ CONDA_PY }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
  skip: true  # [py<312 or py>=315]
  script:
    - export CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja  # [linux]
    # The Visual Studio generator cannot compile CUDA without the MSBuild
    # integration of the CUDA toolkit.  Ninja takes no platform or toolset.
    - set "CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja"  # [win]
    - set "CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM="  # [win]
    - set "CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET="  # [win]
    # The CUDA kernels need compute capability 7.0 (Volta).  CUDA 12 still
    # targets older devices by default; drop them from the default list.
    - export CUDAARCHS="${CUDAARCHS//50-real;52-real;60-real;61-real;/}"  # [linux and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
    - set "CUDAARCHS=%CUDAARCHS:50-real;52-real;60-real;61-real;=%"  # [win and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
    # Without xsimd the build silently drops the SIMD kernels, so require it
    - {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation -Ccmake.define.CMAKE_REQUIRE_FIND_PACKAGE_xsimd=ON -Ccmake.define.SRREAL_CUDA={{ srreal_cuda }}

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}              # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - m2-patch                            # [win]
    - python                              # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - nanobind >=3.1,<4                   # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - setuptools-scm >=8
    - nanobind >=3.1,<4
    - libboost-devel
    - gsl
    # conda-forge's libgslcblas is a symlink to the BLAS-switchable libcblas
    - libcblas
    - xsimd >=14
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-cudart-dev                             # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - pyobjcryst
    - periodictable
    - diffpy.structure
    # Leaves the CPU variant to machines without a CUDA driver
    - __cuda                                      # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    # cuda-cudart-dev has run_exports on Linux only
    - cuda-cudart                                 # [win and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]

test:
  source_files:
    - tests
  files:
    - check_kernels.py
  imports:
    - diffpy.srreal
    - diffpy.srreal.srreal_ext
  requires:
    - pip
    - pytest
  commands:
    - pip check
    - test -f $SP_DIR/diffpy/srreal/data/bvparm2011sel.cif  # [unix]
    - if not exist %SP_DIR%\diffpy\srreal\data\bvparm2011sel.cif exit 1  # [win]
    - python check_kernels.py         # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
    - python check_kernels.py --cuda  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - pytest
